description: Header file defining classes related to EGL images in the ANGLE project, including egl::Image, egl::ImageSibling, and ExternalImageSibling, with associated methods and internal state management.

classes.name: ImageSibling
classes.description: Represents a sibling EGL image, manages relationships with source and target images, and handles state changes.

classes.name: ExternalImageSibling
classes.description: Wraps EGLImage sources that are platform-specific and not owned by ANGLE, providing additional queries for format and size.

classes.name: ImageState
classes.description: Holds the internal state of an EGL image, including format, size, and associated siblings.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an EGL image object, manages its lifecycle, state, and implementation details.

methods.name: Image::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the EGL image with the display, setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: Image::getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the EGL image.

methods.name: Image::isRenderable
methods.description: Checks if the image can be used as a render target.

methods.name: Image::orphaned
methods.description: Checks if the image has been orphaned.
